fields.statement: QA cycle 1: built rhiza from the branch to a scratch path and ran rhiza run start --foreground in a hermetic Rhiza root with a fake rex and a fake claude whose transcript ended in the synthetic isApiErrorMessage line 'Please run /login · API Error: 403 Attention Required! | Cloudflare' after a model line. The Claude Code adapter recognised it end to end: the error text reached the session record, the inbox and the re-prompt messages verbatim. go test -trimpath ./internal/adapter/... and ./internal/api -run 'SessionRun|UsageLearn|SessionInterview|SessionAsk' pass.

QA cycle 1: with the built binary, an owner-attended run whose session ended on an API error showed in rhiza inbox --json as kind api-error with the session, run, step build, detail 'session <id> stopped on an API error: Please run /login · API Error: 403 ...' and next 'rhiza session message <id> <text>'; the text inbox showed the same; no stalled item. A working hook report (rhiza session hook UserPromptSubmit) cleared the item. Scoped tests for internal/session, internal/tui/inboxapp, internal/api -run 'WebInbox|InboxNotice' and TestScripts/inbox-api-error and describe-golden pass.

QA cycle 1: built binary, autonomous run (--autonomous) whose fake claude ended its transcript in the Cloudflare API error and stayed open. session run recorded idle with no detail and sent three re-prompts via rex send at 12:05:47, 12:08:17 and 12:12:17 (1m, 2m, 4m backoff after the 30s poll), each message 'Your last turn ended on an API error: <text>. Carry on where you left off.'; inbox snapshots every 15s listed no api-error and no stalled item during retries; after the fourth backoff (12:16:47) the record held 'stopped on an API error: <text>', the inbox listed it once, and no fourth message went out. An owner-attended run's session sent no message and was recorded at the first poll. go test -trimpath ./internal/api/ -run SessionRunAPIError passes.
